title: Protein Purification for OnePot PURE Cell-Free System
author: Konstantinos Ragios
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8auhsew

steps.title: Prepare Initial Cultures
steps.instruction: Prepare the growth media and inoculate the bacterial strains under sterile conditions.

substeps.instruction: Sterilize the bench with 70% Ethanol under a flame.
Prepare 10ml of autoclaved LB medium supplemented with 100μg/ml Ampicillin.
Fill 35 wells of a 96 deep-well plate with 0.3 ml of the LB medium according to the pattern of the stored strains.
Add 3ml of LB medium to a standard 14ml culture tube for the EF-Tu culture (prepare an additional tube if performing two purification batches).

steps.title: Inoculate Bacterial Strains
steps.instruction: Inoculate the prepared media with the bacterial stocks.

substeps.instruction: Add 20-50μl of the stored strain with EF-Tu encoding plasmid to the 14ml culture tube.
Use a sterilized 96-well replicator (disinfected with ethanol and flame) to inoculate the deep-well plate from the bacterial stock.

If starting without a stored plate, add strains to respective wells without significantly altering the 0.3ml volume; after culture, create a stock by adding 40% glycerol in a 1:1 ratio and store at -80°C.

steps.title: Incubate Overnight Cultures
steps.instruction: Grow the cultures overnight under aerobic conditions.

substeps.instruction: Cover the deep-well plate with a Breath-Easy sealing membrane.
Incubate overnight (12-16 hours) at 37°C, rotating at 260 rpm.

steps.title: Scale Up Culture
steps.instruction: Prepare a larger volume culture for protein expression.

substeps.instruction: Sterilize the bench with 70% Ethanol under a flame.
Add 500ml of autoclaved LB medium into a 1L baffled flask and supplement with 100μg/ml Ampicillin.
Inoculate the LB with 1675μl from the overnight EF-Tu culture and 55μl from each of the other 35 cultures.

steps.title: Induce Protein Expression
steps.instruction: Incubate and induce the culture to express proteins.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 2 hours at 37°C, rotating at 260 rpm.
Induct with 0.1mM IPTG and continue incubating for 3 more hours.
Precool the centrifuge to 4°C.
Harvest cells into two tubes by centrifugation at 4000rpm for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Optional: Store tubes at -80°C overnight.

steps.title: Resuspend Cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in Buffer A.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 7.5 ml of Buffer A by adding 7mM β-Mercaptethanol.
Use 5ml of Buffer A to resuspend cells in the first tube, then transfer the solution to the second tube and resuspend.
Use the remaining 2.5 ml of buffer to wash the first tube and move the solution to the second tube.

steps.title: Lyse Cells by Sonication
steps.instruction: Break open the cells using a probe sonicator.

substeps.instruction: Clean the sonicator by running a working cycle with a tube of milli-Q water.
Sonicate the solution using a 6mm probe tip for 4 cycles (20s on / 20s off) at 70% amplitude.
Keep the tube on ice during sonication to prevent heating.

steps.title: Clarify Lysate
steps.instruction: Remove cell debris from the lysate.

substeps.instruction: Precool the centrifuge to 4°C.
Centrifuge the lysate at 15000rpm for 20 minutes at 4°C.

steps.title: Prepare IMAC Column
steps.instruction: Set up and equilibrate the chromatography column.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 2 ml of IMAC Sepharose 6 FF into an Econo-Pac chromatography column.
Charge the column with 15ml of 100mM Nickel sulfate solution (skip this if using ready-to-use Ni-NTA resin).
Wash with 50ml of DEMI Water, ensuring the resin does not dry out.
Equilibrate with 35ml of Buffer A containing β-Mercaptoethanol.

steps.title: Protein Binding and Washing
steps.instruction: Bind the proteins to the resin and remove unbound contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Load the supernatant from the clarification step into the column and incubate at 4°C, rotating slowly for 3 hours.
Allow the unbound lysate to flow through the column.
Wash with 25ml of wash buffer (95% Buffer A and 5% Buffer B).

steps.title: Elute and Regenerate Resin
steps.instruction: Recover the proteins and clean the resin for reuse.

substeps.instruction: Elute proteins using 5ml of Elution buffer (10% Buffer A and 90% Buffer B) and collect the solution.
Regenerate the resin with 10ml of a mixture of 0.2M EDTA and 0.5M NaCl.
Wash with 30ml of 0.5M NaCl.
Wash with 30ml of DEMI water.
Store the resin in 20% Ethanol at 4°C.

steps.title: Concentrate and Buffer Exchange
steps.instruction: Concentrate the eluted proteins and exchange the buffer.

substeps.instruction: Mix the 5ml elution solution with 25ml of HT Buffer.
Load half of the solution into a 15ml Amicon Ultra filter (3 kDa) and centrifuge for 60 minutes at 4000 rpm at 4°C.
Load the second half into the same filter and centrifuge for another hour (expected volume ~1ml).
Dilute the concentrated sample with 10 ml of HT Buffer and concentrate again to 1.5ml (1 hour centrifugation).

steps.title: Final Concentration and Storage
steps.instruction: Perform final concentration, measurement, and storage.

substeps.instruction: Measure the exact volume and add Stock Buffer B at a 1:1 ratio.
Concentrate the solution using a 0.5ml Amicon Ultra filter (3 kDa) by centrifugation at 14000rpm for 30min at 4°C.
Mix 24μl of water with 1μl of the concentrated solution and vortex.
Perform a Nanodrop measurement; calculate concentration by multiplying by 25 and dividing by 0.5 (extinction coefficient).
Adjust final concentration to 12.25mg/mL by concentrating further or diluting with Stock Buffer B.
Store the protein solution at -80°C.
